basis_statement: Resume fails closed whenever epoch, compaction, route, shell, session, access, masking, or schema truth drifts away from the authoritative stream recovery contract.

trigger_rows.summary: Frame epoch advanced, so the client must replace local frame state before consuming further events.
notes: Epoch seams are explicit and never stitched client-side.

trigger_rows.summary: The requested sequence fell behind the compaction floor and now requires a fresh snapshot baseline.
notes: Compaction never degrades into best-effort replay heuristics.

trigger_rows.summary: Shell stability token drifted, so mounted continuity is no longer trustworthy.
notes: Reconnect cannot silently remount into a different shell grammar.

trigger_rows.summary: Route or mounted subject drifted, so the client must rebase on a fresh route-bound snapshot.
notes: Raw resume tokens never authorize a different route or subject.

trigger_rows.summary: Session identity or session binding drifted, so access must be rebound before replay resumes.
notes: Session continuity is part of the authoritative recovery tuple.

trigger_rows.summary: Access binding drifted and blocks further live replay until the user rebinds access.
Masking posture drifted and invalidated the prior cursor bind.
notes: Customer-safe and staff-visible projections must not cross masking binds.

trigger_rows.summary: Schema or publication generation drifted enough to require a fresh recovery contract and bind.
notes: Mixed-generation payload sets are not lawful.

source_lineage.rationale: Encodes the fail-closed resume semantics from the northbound contract and stream recovery schema into a reusable runtime matrix.
